ObtainInformationOnPurchasableDisks.clientToken: Idempotency token, an ASCII string of no more than 64 characters. See [Idempotency](BCC/API参考/通用说明.md#幂等性) for details.
ObtainInformationOnPurchasableDisks.zoneName: Zone information. The zoneName naming convention is "country-region-availability zone sequence" in lowercase, e.g., "cn-bj-a" for Beijing availability zone A. If an empty string or an invalid zone is passed, information on purchasable disks for all availability zones is returned.
